aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: All primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The registry_to_core dependency is the primary signal because core URL/open behavior is sensitive to stale protocol lookup and filesystem instantiation assumptions.
The utils_to_core dependency captures stale assumptions around URL parsing, path expansion, read blocks, and compression lookup.
The backends_to_core dependency captures the abstract filesystem and local, memory, and cache contracts exercised indirectly by the public core evaluator.
Revision v0.3.2 closes the dependency graph over the stripped backend production files already exercised by public tests.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Protocol registry lookup, deferred implementation import, and filesystem instantiation must be stable for url_to_fs, open_files, and core list/open behavior.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when registry probes and core URL/open consumer probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The core agent may implement URL and open behavior around stale registry lookup or class-instantiation assumptions.

dependency_points.contract_summary: URL/protocol parsing, path expansion helpers, read-block utilities, and compression registration must support core OpenFile/OpenFiles behavior.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when utility/compression probes and core path/compression consumer probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The core agent may implement path expansion or compression selection against stale utility/compression contracts.

dependency_points.contract_summary: AbstractFileSystem and the local, memory, and cache backends must provide the open, info, glob, parent, cache mapping, and local-file behavior consumed by core OpenFile/open_local paths.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when backend open/cache probes and core OpenFile/open_local consumer probes pass together after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The core agent may implement OpenFile or open_local around stale backend return values or filesystem method semantics.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves fsspec registry, utility, and backend contracts consumed by core open/path behavior.
